import json

OUT = "/Users/yuluo/Desktop/game/games_test/reverse-engineering/tiny-glade/evidence/toolchain/clutter/disasm/"
prog = currentProgram
ADDRS = {"0x1422ce260":"process_autoclutter_candidates","0x1422cc390":"add_autoclutter_around_gates","0x1422cefe0":"add_autoclutter_around_windows","0x1422cd7d0":"add_autoclutter_on_windows","0x1422c9c70":"add_birdnests","0x1422d2fa0":"add_lantern_water_setdresssing","0x1422d3800":"add_tree_setdressing","0x1422d04e0":"manage_autoclutter_entities"}
fm = prog.getFunctionManager()
listing = prog.getListing()
refmgr = prog.getReferenceManager()
res = {}
for s, label in ADDRS.items():
    monitor.checkCancelled()
    addr = prog.getAddressFactory().getAddress(s)
    f = fm.getFunctionAt(addr)
    rec = {"addr": s, "label": label}
    if f is None:
        rec["error"] = "absent"
        res[s] = rec
        continue
    rec["name"] = str(f.getName())
    body = f.getBody()
    it = listing.getInstructions(body, True)
    insns = []
    calls = {}
    while it.hasNext():
        monitor.checkCancelled()
        ins = it.next()
        a = ins.getAddress()
        mnem = ins.getMnemonicString()
        ops = []
        for i in range(ins.getNumOperands()):
            r = ins.getDefaultOperandRepresentation(i)
            ops.append(r if r is not None else "")
        raw = ins.getBytes()
        hexb = "".join("%02x" % (b & 0xFF) for b in raw)
        insns.append([str(a), mnem, ops, hexb])
        if mnem == "CALL":
            for r in refmgr.getReferencesFrom(a):
                if r.getReferenceType().isCall():
                    to = r.getToAddress()
                    tgt = fm.getFunctionAt(to)
                    nm = str(tgt.getName()) if tgt else str(to)
                    key = nm + "@" + str(to)
                    if key not in calls:
                        calls[key] = 0
                    calls[key] += 1
    rec["insn_count"] = len(insns)
    rec["insns"] = insns
    rec["call_counts"] = calls
    open(OUT + label + ".json", "w").write(json.dumps(rec, indent=1))
    res[s] = {"addr": s, "label": label, "name": rec.get("name"), "insn_count": len(insns), "calls": calls}
print(json.dumps(res))
